scope: Implementation readiness for the V2 relational sample/accession lineage shadow backfill and completed-run replay hardening

criteria.description: The authorized implementation outcome, scope and acceptance bar for the bounded relational shadow slice are explicit and traceable
criteria.limitations: This gate authorizes only the bounded local shadow implementation and does not authorize relational cutover, clinical use or production release

criteria.description: Dependencies, interfaces, risks and the executable RED/GREEN sequence are frozen from current evidence
criteria.limitations: Full 007–010 mapping, target-environment operations and authority promotion are explicitly outside this implementation-ready boundary

criteria.description: Fail-closed verification, safe disposable PostgreSQL execution, rollback behavior and authority boundaries are defined before material data edits
criteria.limitations: The harness requires a dedicated disposable loopback database and must not reuse or reset the existing DATABASE_URL or PostgreSQL process

authority.actor: No external authority required for bounded local implementation readiness
authority.scope: Implementation readiness for the V2 relational sample/accession lineage shadow backfill and completed-run replay hardening
authority.decision: Authorize only local synthetic/disposable implementation and verification within the frozen boundary
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate on real clinical data, target infrastructure, destructive migration, authority promotion or material scope expansion

next_action: Proceed only within the bounded local implementation and verification sequence; obtain a separate VERIFIED decision for acceptance
revalidation_triggers: real clinical data, target database or external infrastructure access
full relational mapping, dual-read or authority/cutover design
new CRITICAL risk, cross-system blast radius or policy requirement
